CCTV **CAM-02** confirms standing water across the carriageway, so cars may stall or lose control. **Close the road now** and send a drainage crew.
RG-001.recommendedAction: Close the road and dispatch a drainage crew.
RG-001.crewTask: Clear the blocked drains and pump out the standing water.

residents.messageOpen: Water is rising on the road. Avoid the area and use Elmina Park Access instead.

residents.message: Road flooding. Use Elmina Park Access instead and never drive through floodwater.

RG-002.recommendedAction: Send an arborist to inspect before the wind picks up.
RG-002.crewTask: Inspect tree T-204 and make it safe before the wind picks up.

residents.messageOpen: Crews are checking a roadside tree. Expect slow traffic and keep clear of the work area.
